[[Sogndal Municipality]] | capacity = 5,622 | chairman = Tor Arne Ness | manager = [[Eirik Bakke]] (interim) | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = [[1. divisjon]] | season = [[2025 Norwegian First Division|2025]] | position = 1. divisjon, 8th of 16 | website = {{URL|http://www.sogndalfotball.no/}} | shirtsupplier= | shirtsponsors= | pattern_la1=_sogndal21h|pattern_b1=_sogndal21h|pattern_ra1=_sogndal21h|pattern_sh1=_ilsb20h | leftarm1=FFFFFF|body1=FFFFFF|rightarm1=FFFFFFFF| shorts1=000000|socks1=000000 | pattern_la2=_sogndal21a|pattern_b2=_sogndal21a|pattern_ra2=_sogndal21a|pattern_sh2 =_ilsb20h|pattern_so2 = | leftarm2=000000|body2=000000|rightarm2=000000|shorts2=000000|socks2=000000 }} '''Sogndal Fotball''' is the [[Association football|football]] department of Norwegian sports club [[Sogndal IL]] from [[Sogndal Municipality]] in [[Vestland]]. The club was founded in 1926. The men's team currently plays in second tier [[1. divisjon]] of the [[Norwegian football league system]]. The club's home matches are played at the 5,622 capacity [[Fosshaugane Campus]].{{cite web |url=https://www.sogndalfotball.no/fosshaugane |title=Fakta om Fosshaugane Campus |website=sogndalfotball.no |publisher=Sogndal Fotball |language=no |access-date=24 January 2020}} The men's team contests for the [[Norwegian Football Cup|Norwegian Cup]]. They achieved for the first time play in the [[1976 Norwegian Football Cup|1976 Norwegian Cup final]] phase. They were unsuccessful in the pursuit of the [[1976 Norwegian Football Cup|1976 Norwegian Cup]] as runner-up in the [[1976 Norwegian Football Cup|1976 Norwegian Cup]], losing to [[SK Brann]] 2-1.{{cite web |url=https://www.nrk.no/sognogfjordane/40-ar-sidan-den-storste-kampen-1.13189911 |title=40 år sidan den største kampen |website=nrk.no |publisher=[[NRK]] |language=no |date=24 October 2016 |access-date=24 January 2020}} Sogndal became the first third-tier side to play in a Norwegian Cup final. Sogndal men's team contests in the top division [[Eliteserien]]. They contested in the [[2017 Eliteserien|2017 season]].{{cite web |url=https://www.dagbladet.no/sport/eirik-bakke-blir-ny-trener-i-sogndal/61406198 |title=Eirik Bakke blir ny trener i Sogndal |website=dagbladet.no |publisher=[[Dagbladet]] |language=no |date=13 June 2014 |access-date=24 January 2020}}"}}
